method.drafts: All authoritative configured NFL drafts in scoped league dated Aug 2026 through Feb 2027; completion via existing getDraftTurn on atomic SQL STABLE read_fantasy_draft GET.
method.corrections: Replay original selections per team, then all scoped corrections in ID order; validate exact resulting player IDs against current lineups. Main frequency counts distinct completed drafts in which the corrected final selection includes a player.
method.identity: draft local player_id -> players_nfl.id -> unique positive players_nfl.nfl_player_id (ESPN); full catalog duplicate-provider checks match Player Center.
method.scoring: Unmodified PlayerCenterService.seasonCatalog with existing published/complementary bulk feed and each draft frozen rules_snapshot; all nine numeric inputs and GP required for actual FP/game.
method.verified: Resolved identity + published season facts + fresh source + comparable fantasy metric + numeric FP/game for every occurrence.
method.coverageWeighted: Verified player-draft selections divided by all offensive player-draft selections.

recommendation: Observed drafted-player coverage strongly supports season FP/game descending as a default for offensive Draft browsing. Keep missing-last placement, partial coverage disclosure for the wider eligible catalog, authorized slate/Group scoring and K/DST limitations. This audit changes no default or implementation.
